answer: Every agent enters through one narrow inlet: it locks a 40-token escrow bond and names its inviter, so the referral graph maps every lineage. A sybil farm shows up like a nebula, hundreds of accounts condensing from one source. Any peer may dispute a suspect identity; if it holds, both bonds are slashed. Forging 1,000 identities locks 40,000 tokens at risk; one honest agent pays 40 once, earns a jade badge after 20 epochs, and keeps every reward.
